presentation.metaDescription: Who XBZ Esport is: a competitive, organised and ambitious organisation, active on Rocket League.
presentation.title: Who are we?
presentation.intro: A competitive, organised and ambitious esports organisation — built to progress together on <game>Rocket League</game>.
presentation.pitch1: XBZ Esport is a fast-growing competitive organisation, created to bring together driven, serious and ambitious players around a shared goal: to improve and perform in esports.
presentation.pitch2: We are active on <game>Rocket League</game>, with a simple vision: build solid, consistent teams able to play at a genuinely competitive level.
presentation.pitch3: This isn’t just a community. It’s a structured organisation, with defined roles, an active staff and a real commitment to long-term growth.
presentation.pitch4: Every player, creator or staff member has an important part in how the project grows. Activity, motivation and team spirit are the foundations of XBZ.

competition.title: Competition
competition.text: Aiming high and performing in a demanding setting, match after match.

cgv.metaDescription: The terms and conditions of sale of the XBZ Esport online shop.
cgv.title: Terms of sale
cgv.objetBody:
These terms of sale govern the sale of products offered on the XBZ Esport online shop. Any order implies full acceptance of these terms, which the customer acknowledges having read before placing the order.

The terms applicable are those in force on the date of the order.
cgv.vendeurBody:
Products are sold by {association}, a {form}, registered in the French national register of associations under number {rna} (SIREN {siren} — SIRET of the registered office {siret} — intra-Community VAT number {vat}), with registered office at {address}.

Contact: {email} — phone: {phone} — also reachable via the club's Discord.
cgv.produitsBody: Products are described and presented as accurately as possible; their main characteristics appear on each product's page. Photographs are as faithful as possible but cannot guarantee a perfect likeness (colours, details). Products are offered while stocks last.
cgv.prixBody:
Prices are shown in euros, all taxes included (VAT at the rate in force included), excluding delivery charges. These charges are shown in the cart before the order is confirmed. {association} reserves the right to change its prices at any time; products are invoiced on the basis of the prices in force at the time of the order.

The price is payable in full, at once, when the order is placed.
cgv.commandeBody:
The order is definitively confirmed once payment is confirmed. A payment receipt is sent by Stripe to the address the customer gave when paying. An invoice can be obtained on request at {email}.

Each order is archived electronically and kept for ten (10) years. The customer may obtain a copy at any time on request at {email}, from the address used for the order.

{association} reserves the right to cancel any order in the event of non-payment, a product being out of stock, delivery to the address given being impossible, or proven fraud; the customer is informed and, if already charged, fully refunded as soon as possible and no later than fourteen (14) days.
cgv.paiementBody: Payment is made online by bank card, through the secure Stripe platform. No card details are entered or stored by XBZ Esport: payment is processed directly by Stripe. The order is recorded only after Stripe confirms payment.
cgv.livraisonBody:
Products are delivered to the address given at the time of the order. {association} undertakes to deliver them no later than {days} working days after payment is confirmed. Delivery charges are shown before the order is confirmed. Delivery is available to metropolitan France, Monaco, Belgium, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Germany, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands and Portugal.

Switzerland is not part of the European Union: customs duties, taxes or import fees may be charged on delivery by the authorities or the carrier. They are borne by the customer and are not included in the price.

In the event of delay, the customer is informed as soon as possible. If the products are not delivered within the stated time, the customer may terminate the contract under Article L.216-2 of the French Consumer Code: by registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt or by another written durable medium, after having called on {association} to deliver within an additional reasonable period and if delivery has not taken place within that period; or immediately if {association} refuses to deliver, or if the delivery date was an essential condition of the contract for the customer. {association} then refunds all sums paid no later than fourteen (14) days after termination (Article L.216-3 of the French Consumer Code).

Risk passes to the customer when they physically take possession of the products (Article L.216-4 of the French Consumer Code). If a parcel is damaged, the customer is asked to note their reservations with the carrier on delivery and to inform {association} at {email}.
cgv.retractationBody:
In accordance with Articles L.221-18 et seq. of the French Consumer Code, the customer has fourteen (14) days from receipt of the products to exercise their right of withdrawal, without giving any reason or paying a penalty.

To exercise it, the customer informs {association} of their decision by an unambiguous statement (postal letter to {address} or email to {email}; the model form below may be used) before the deadline.

The customer returns the products without undue delay, and no later than fourteen (14) days after communicating their decision, to the following address: {returnAddress}. The customer is invited to return the products in packaging that protects them during transport, preferably in their original packaging, with their accessories and tags. Return costs are borne by the customer. The customer is only liable for any loss in value of the products resulting from handling other than what is necessary to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning.

{association} refunds all payments received, including the initial delivery costs (standard delivery), no later than fourteen (14) days after being informed of the decision to withdraw. The refund may be withheld until the products have been recovered or until the customer provides proof of having sent them back, whichever is earlier. It is made using the same means of payment as the one used for the order.

The right of withdrawal does not apply to products made or personalised to the customer's specifications (Article L.221-28 of the French Consumer Code).
cgv.retractationForm:
To {association}, {address}, {email}:
I hereby give notice of my withdrawal from the contract for the order below:
— Ordered on [date] / received on [date]
— Order number: [number]
— Customer name: [name]
— Customer address: [address]
— Date: [date]
— Signature (only if notified on paper):
cgv.garantiesBody:
All products benefit from the legal guarantee of conformity (Articles L.217-3 et seq. of the French Consumer Code) and the legal guarantee against hidden defects (Articles 1641 to 1649 of the French Civil Code), independently of any commercial guarantee. How these legal guarantees are implemented is set out in the box below.

To make use of these guarantees, the customer contacts {association} by email at {email}, by phone on {phone} or by post at {address}.

If the goods cannot be brought into conformity where they are, and they can be returned by post without major inconvenience to the customer or costs disproportionate to their value, the customer sends them by post to the following address: {returnAddress}. Postage is borne by {association}, repair or replacement being free of charge for the customer. Otherwise, {association} tells the customer the practical arrangements for collecting the goods, at no cost to them. The customer cannot be required to arrange or pay for any transport other than a postal shipment.
cgv.garantiesEncadre:
The consumer has a period of two years from delivery of the goods to obtain the implementation of the legal guarantee of conformity if a lack of conformity appears. During this period, the consumer is only required to establish that the lack of conformity exists, not the date on which it appeared.

Where the sales contract for the goods provides for the continuous supply of digital content or a digital service for a period of more than two years, the legal guarantee applies to that digital content or digital service throughout the planned supply period. During this period, the consumer is only required to establish that the lack of conformity affecting the digital content or digital service exists, not the date on which it appeared.

The legal guarantee of conformity obliges the professional, where applicable, to supply all updates necessary to maintain the conformity of the goods.

The legal guarantee of conformity entitles the consumer to have the goods repaired or replaced within thirty days of their request, free of charge and without major inconvenience to them.

If the goods are repaired under the legal guarantee of conformity, the consumer benefits from a six-month extension of the original guarantee.

If the consumer asks for the goods to be repaired but the seller imposes replacement, the legal guarantee of conformity is renewed for a period of two years from the date of replacement of the goods.

The consumer may obtain a reduction of the purchase price while keeping the goods, or end the contract and be fully refunded against return of the goods, if:
1° The professional refuses to repair or replace the goods;
2° The repair or replacement of the goods takes place after a period of thirty days;
3° The repair or replacement of the goods causes major inconvenience to the consumer, in particular where the consumer permanently bears the costs of collecting or removing the non-conforming goods, or bears the costs of installing the repaired or replacement goods;
4° The lack of conformity persists despite the seller's unsuccessful attempt to bring the goods into conformity.

The consumer is also entitled to a reduction of the price of the goods or to termination of the contract where the lack of conformity is so serious that it justifies an immediate price reduction or termination. The consumer is then not required to ask for repair or replacement of the goods beforehand.

The consumer is not entitled to termination of the sale if the lack of conformity is minor.

Any period during which the goods are immobilised for repair or replacement suspends the guarantee that remained to run until the repaired goods are delivered back.

The rights mentioned above result from the application of Articles L. 217-1 to L. 217-32 of the French Consumer Code.

A seller who in bad faith obstructs the implementation of the legal guarantee of conformity incurs a civil fine of up to EUR 300,000, which may be raised up to 10% of average annual turnover (Article L. 241-5 of the French Consumer Code).

The consumer also benefits from the legal guarantee against hidden defects under Articles 1641 to 1649 of the French Civil Code, for two years from discovery of the defect. This guarantee entitles the consumer to a price reduction if the goods are kept, or to a full refund against return of the goods.
cgv.garantiesEncadreNote: Courtesy translation of the model box annexed to Article D. 211-2 of the French Consumer Code. The French text prevails.
cgv.responsabiliteBody: {association} cannot be held liable for failure to perform the contract where it results from the customer's own act, from force majeure within the meaning of Article 1218 of the French Civil Code, or from the unforeseeable and unavoidable act of a third party unconnected with the supply of the products. If an item turns out to be out of stock after the order, the customer is informed and refunded. These provisions do not limit the customer's statutory rights.
cgv.donneesBody: The data collected when placing an order is necessary for its processing and delivery. It is handled by {association} in accordance with our privacy policy.
cgv.litigesBody:
These terms are governed by French law, without prejudice to the mandatory consumer-protection provisions of the law of the country where the customer habitually resides.

In the event of a difficulty, the customer is invited to first contact {association} in writing at {email}, which will endeavour to find an amicable solution. Failing a satisfactory reply, the customer may use a consumer mediator free of charge: {mediator}.

Failing an amicable settlement, the French courts have jurisdiction, without prejudice to the jurisdiction rules that protect consumers.

legal.dataText1: The recruitment and support forms, and shop orders, only collect the information needed to handle your request or your order. This data is never sold or passed on to third parties.

privacy.metaDescription: How XBZ Esport collects, uses, stores and protects your personal data (recruitment, support and shop), and how to exercise your GDPR rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data {name} collects through its forms, why, how long it is kept, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.controllerText: The data collected on this site is processed by {association}, a {form} (RNA {rna} — SIREN {siren}), with registered office at {address}. For any question about your data, contact us via <discord>the official Discord server</discord><mail> or by email at </mail>.
privacy.collectedIntro: We collect the information you provide voluntarily, as well as the information the staff enter to present the organisation’s members:

collected.recruitment: Recruitment form: category, desired role, full name, age, country of residence, Discord username, username, game, RL Tracker link (optional), experience and motivation (optional), preferred roster (optional).
collected.support: Support form: name or username, email address, subject and body of your message.
collected.antispam: Anti-spam protection: when a form is submitted or a payment is opened, your IP address is briefly recorded to limit repeated attempts. It is never associated with the content of your message and is deleted automatically, at the latest within 24 hours.
collected.orders: Shop orders: items ordered, amount, name, email address and shipping address — entered on the Stripe payment page and needed to place and deliver an order. Your card details are handled by Stripe only: they never go through our site and we have no access to them.
collected.staff: Back-office sign-in: if you click “Sign in with Discord” (or use an email + password account), your Discord ID, username and email address — or your email and an encrypted password — are recorded with our authentication provider (Supabase); for authorised staff, your roles on the server are added.
collected.members: Public member profiles: username, name, photo, country, bio, rank, achievements and social-media links, entered by the staff for the players and staff members presented on the site.
collected.logs: Technical logs and error reports: our hosts keep technical logs (IP address, date, page requested, browser), and site errors (error message, page, date) are sent to the staff on Discord. They normally contain only technical information.

privacy.collectedOutro: The mandatory fields of the forms and the payment page are needed to process your request or order: without them it cannot go through. No sensitive data is requested. We use neither advertising cookies nor trackers (see the <legal>legal notice</legal>).
privacy.purposeText1: The data from your recruitment and support forms is used solely to process your application or to answer your support request, and to get back to you about it.
privacy.purposeText2: The legal basis for processing is your consent (GDPR article 6.1.a), collected via the checkbox on each form. That consent is timestamped when you submit.
privacy.purposeText3: The anti-spam protection described above relies instead on our legitimate interest (GDPR article 6.1.f) in protecting the site from automated submissions.
privacy.purposeText4: Order data is used to prepare, ship and follow up on your order (customer service, returns, warranties). Processing it is necessary to perform the sales contract (GDPR article 6.1.b), then to meet our accounting obligations (article 6.1.c).
privacy.purposeText5: Back-office access relies on our legitimate interest (GDPR article 6.1.f) in reserving the administration area for authorised members only and in securing the data it holds.
privacy.purposeText6: The public profiles of players and staff present the organisation on the site. They are published with the member’s agreement (consent, GDPR article 6.1.a, and image-rights authorisation), which they may withdraw at any time by contacting us: the profile and photo are then removed from the site. For a minor, the authorisation of their legal guardians is requested.
privacy.purposeText7: To run and secure the site and measure its traffic, we use technical logs, error reports and cookieless audience measurement. These rely on our legitimate interest (GDPR article 6.1.f); you may object by contacting us (see “Your rights”).
privacy.retentionText: The data from your recruitment and support forms is kept for {months} months from the date you send it in our database, then deleted automatically. The copy of the form sent to the staff on Discord is deleted by the staff within the same period. You can request deletion at any time before that (see “Your rights”).
privacy.retentionOrdersText: Orders are the exception: they are accounting records, kept for 10 years as required by law, then deleted or anonymised.
privacy.retentionStaffText: Staff sign-in data is kept for as long as the person holds a role that requires access, then deleted; the account of a person refused at sign-in is deleted straight away. Members’ public profiles are kept for as long as the person belongs to the organisation, then removed when they leave or on request.
privacy.recipientsText: The data from your forms is accessible only to the {name} staff authorised to handle applications and support; members’ public profiles, on the other hand, are visible to everyone. Your data is never sold or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.processorsIntro: To operate, the website relies on the following technical providers:

processors.supabase: Supabase — hosting of the database where applications, messages, orders, member profiles and sign-in accounts are stored (Paris region, France).
processors.vercel: Vercel — website hosting, technical logs and cookieless audience measurement (aggregated visit statistics).
processors.discord: Discord — when a form is received, the full copy of your application or message (including your email address for support) is posted by our bot in a staff channel; technical error reports are also sent there.
processors.stripe: Stripe — secure payment of shop orders (Stripe Payments Europe, Ireland). Stripe also acts as a controller for its own obligations (fraud prevention): see stripe.com/privacy.

privacy.rightsText: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and object to processing, the right to data portability, and the right to withdraw your consent at any time.
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise these rights, contact us via <discord>the official Discord server</discord><mail> or at </mail>. We will reply within one month, extendable by two months for a complex request (you would be informed). If there is reasonable doubt about your identity, we may ask for proof of identity.
privacy.rightsComplaint: You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority — <cnil>cnil.fr</cnil>.
privacy.transfersText1: Vercel (site hosting), Discord (internal notifications) and Stripe (payment) are US companies: the data these providers process may therefore be transferred to the United States. These transfers rely on the European Commission’s adequacy decision for companies certified under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and, failing that, on the Commission’s standard contractual clauses, included in these providers’ data processing terms. You can obtain a copy by contacting us (see “Your rights”).
privacy.transfersText2: The database is hosted in Paris by Supabase (Supabase Inc., a US company); any access from outside the European Union is covered by Supabase’s standard contractual clauses.
privacy.rightsPostMortem: You may also set directives on the retention, deletion and disclosure of your data after your death.
